## SignaturePad.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `paths` :: Recorded SVG path strings for each completed stroke; bindable.
- `onPathsChange` :: Called whenever the stroke list updates (draw or clear).
- `onEnd` :: Called after lifting the pointer with a PNG data URL of the signature.
- `lineWidth` :: Nominal stroke width multiplier.
- `showClear` :: Show a clear action button in the top-right corner when ink exists.
- `showGuide` :: Draw a dashed signature baseline guide inside the pad.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the pad's frame, from `rect` to fully rounded. @default 'modern'
- `surface` :: The recipe of the pad's frame — fill, border and shadow in one; `elevated` is the sheet a signature sits on. @default 'elevated'
- `size` :: The height of the clear button in the corner. @default 'h-sm'
- `textColor` :: The ink of the clear button; muted by default so it stays out of the way of the ink on the pad.
- `disabled` :: Disables drawing and clearing.
- `label` :: Accessible label describing what is being signed.

## signature-pad-stroke.ts

### `interface SignaturePadPoint`

One sampled pointer position on the pad.

### `interface SignatureStrokeOptions`

How the ribbon is drawn.

- `size` :: Stroke width at full pressure, in px. Default 2.
- `thinning` :: How much the ribbon narrows at low pressure, 0–1. Default 0.5.
- `simulatePressure` :: Derive pressure from the distance between samples when the device reports none. Default true.

### `type StrokePoint`

A point on the ribbon outline, `[x, y]`.

### `function getStroke`

The outline of the stroke through `points`: the left-hand samples, then the right-hand samples reversed, which `getSvgPathFromStroke` closes into one filled ribbon. `smoothing` and `streamline` are accepted for parity with the Zag props but the ribbon is smoothed by the mid-point quads in `getSvgPathFromStroke` rather than by extra resampling.

### `function getSvgPathFromStroke`

Serializes an outline into the closed `M`/`Q`/`T` path string Zag draws, verbatim.
